fusions.name: Maul of Many Mouths
fusions.desc: A wide maul that deals 30 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and heals you for 20% of the damage dealt. Against a boss or an elite it also deals 6% of their maximum health.

fusions.name: Swarmweight Slam
fusions.desc: Drops the weight of the swarm on one target, dealing 15 damage, stunning it for 1.2 seconds and leaving it 12% easier to wound for 5 seconds. 25% of the damage dealt returns to you as healing over 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Glutted Bulk
fusions.desc: Increases your maximum health by 20% for 20 seconds, and you regain 10 health at once.

fusions.name: Autumn Gorge
fusions.desc: Whenever you are healed, you gain a shield worth 10% of your maximum health for 6 seconds. Once every 15 seconds.
